# Abu Huraira Shaikh — Full Stack Web Developer

> Abu Huraira Shaikh is a Full Stack Web Developer specializing in building modern, responsive, functional, and user-friendly websites and web applications using JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.

## About

Abu Huraira Shaikh is a professional Full Stack Web Developer who helps individuals, businesses, and brands establish their online presence through modern and reliable web solutions.

He builds custom websites and web applications from scratch, focusing on responsive design, user-friendly experiences, clean code, maintainable architecture, and functional backend systems.

From designing attractive frontend interfaces to developing secure backend functionality and integrating APIs, Abu Huraira delivers web solutions tailored to client requirements.

## Services

- Custom Full Stack Web Development
- Frontend Development using React.js

- Functional Web Application Development

- Landing Pages and Multi-Page Websites

- AI-based SEO and AI Optimization (AIO)
